'''Mark Couture''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Waco tournament]] on 20 December 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Flipping Court]], according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1565">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-waco-tx-12-20-00d1565/ waco-tx-12-20-00], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 21 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-waco-tx-12-20-00d1565/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
